title: Underlying curve of an object in a stable moduli fibre
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $g,r$ be natural numbers, let $T$ be an $S$-scheme, and let $C$ be an object of the actual fibre groupoid $\overline{\mathcal M}_{g,r}(T)$ [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Write $X$ for the underlying total curve of $C$, $T_C$ for its recorded base, and $p:X\to T_C$ for its structure morphism. The fibre object includes an equality $e:T_C=T$ in the category of $S$-schemes. Define the underlying curve over the specified fibre base to be the object $X\xrightarrow{p}T_C\xrightarrow{e}T$ of $\mathit{Sch}/T$, transporting the base by that equality. This keeps the actual total curve and structure morphism; it does not choose an isomorphism-class representative. For $r=0$, its automorphisms in $\mathit{Sch}/T$ are precisely the automorphisms of the unpointed $T$-curve.
